dedupe_keys.name: cochilco anuario de estadisticas del cobre y otros minerales chilean copper and minerals statistics yearbook

description: The Anuario de Estadísticas del Cobre y Otros Minerales is the annual statistical yearbook of Chilean mining, updating each year the national and international statistics on copper and other metallic and non-metallic minerals. It includes production and exports, mining taxation, consumption of strategic inputs such as energy, water and sulphuric acid, production costs, investment by the large private mines and the state companies, and the workforce of mining companies and contractors by gender. It is produced by the Comisión Chilena del Cobre (Cochilco), the Chilean government's copper commission. Coverage is national, with some tables by company and mine; the 2025 edition comes with a database of the yearbook series for 2000 to 2025, and editions back to 1986-2005 are listed. Each edition is a free PDF with an XLSX file, and Cochilco also runs an electronic database (BDE) and monthly and daily price bulletins. Caveats: the pages read state no licence, the site is in Spanish, and series definitions change between editions. For simulation it gives the energy, water and acid demand and output of the world's largest copper producer, used to model supply chain disruptions in critical minerals and the resilience of the power and water systems that serve mines. It is related to the World Mining Data record in this catalogue, which gives production by country worldwide.
